title: Automotive Mechanics and Custom Vehicle Construction
description: Identify, design, build and verify automotive parts, evaluate common modifications, and fabricate, assemble and demonstrate your own full-size car.
notice: Independent adult light-vehicle workshop program. Lessons and exam scores track academic progress. Practical completion requires the physical work and a witnessed final car. ASE credentials, EPA Section 609 certification and road approval have separate requirements.
practicalAssessment: Record design and hands-on assessments in each course. The final vehicle demonstration requires independent workshop sign-off.

stages.title: Workshop foundations and maintenance
stages.summary: Service a real vehicle and build the electrical tools and habits needed for diagnosis.
stages.milestone: An authorized work order, an actual service record and a protected circuit with a diagnosed fault.

courses.title: Workshop Measurement and Vehicle Service
outcomes: Select the right service information and measurement tool.
Perform and document a cold tire-pressure service against the vehicle placard.
courses.assignment: A legible service card, before/after readings and a documented follow-up.

courses.title: Preventive Maintenance and Shop Operations
outcomes: Plan due services from use, time, mileage and manufacturer data.
Complete a real oil and filter service, verify the result and close the repair order.
courses.assignment: A serviced vehicle or engine, closed work order and waste transfer record.

courses.title: Automotive Electrical Systems and Diagnosis
outcomes: Predict voltage at points in a loaded circuit.
Build, fault-find and retest a fused lamp harness.
courses.assignment: A labeled circuit, physical harness and healthy/faulted/restored measurement log.

stages.title: Vehicle systems and diagnosis
stages.summary: Follow power, force, heat and signals through the actual vehicle systems.
stages.milestone: A measured wheel end, teaching engine and gear train, plus airflow and diagnostic records.

courses.title: Engine and Drivetrain Service
outcomes: Distinguish compression, timing, lubrication and drive-ratio faults.
Measure a teaching engine and verify its assembly by hand.
courses.assignment: Marked-up service sheet, measurements and a photograph or witnessed record of the reassembled trainer.

courses.title: Transmissions, Clutches and Final Drives
outcomes: Predict ratio and explain the role of clutch, converter and differential.
Measure lash and speed reduction on a physical gear pair.
courses.assignment: A working hand-driven transmission trainer and its verified ratio sheet.

courses.title: Brake, Steering and Suspension Service
outcomes: Separate wear, looseness and hydraulic faults.
Measure a wheel end and demonstrate repeatable inspection.
courses.assignment: An inspected physical wheel end and its completed measurement and disposition sheet.

courses.title: Cooling, Cabin HVAC and Refrigerant Practice
outcomes: Separate air delivery, heat transfer and refrigerant faults.
Build and measure an air-distribution prototype and apply EPA service rules.
courses.assignment: A working HVAC duct prototype, performance record and refrigerant-service decision.

courses.title: Engine Performance, Emissions and Hybrid Diagnostics
outcomes: Select a test that distinguishes a circuit fault from a failed component.
Capture and interpret before/fault/after data without defeating a monitor.
courses.assignment: A scan record, a diagnosed physical trainer and a verified restoration.

courses.title: Electrified Vehicles, ABS and Driver Assistance
outcomes: Recognize energized propulsion and identify the qualified service boundary.
Build and test a physical wheel-speed sensor rig and identify calibration dependencies.
courses.assignment: A tested sensor fixture, waveforms or counts and the model-specific referral record.

stages.title: Vehicle design and fabrication
stages.summary: Produce documented parts from original layouts and build a running engine and full-size suspension corner.
stages.milestone: Tested weld coupons, a welded organizer, inspected chassis bay, running model engine, suspension curves, and a fitted removable body panel.

courses.title: Automotive Welding and Weld Inspection
modules: Theory — Hot work and welding processes
Implementation — GMAW bead and joint practice
outcomes: Select a joining method and lay out a representative test joint.
Make and inspect mild-steel welds, destructively test a plug coupon and measure a finished shop organizer.
courses.assignment: A welded organizer, identified test coupons, inspection results and a witnessed disposition for the capstone portfolio.

courses.title: Chassis Design, Welding and Fabrication
outcomes: Trace loads to structural nodes and dimension a fixture from datums.
Fabricate, inspect and document a representative chassis bay.
courses.assignment: A fabricated bay, its jig, inspected coupons and an as-built dimensional report.

courses.title: Scratch-Built Engines and Precision Machining
outcomes: Choose and verify critical fits, cooling, oiling and timing.
Machine, assemble and demonstrate a physical four-stroke bench engine.
courses.assignment: A running, learner-machined bench engine, inspection sheets and witnessed run record.

courses.title: Suspension Geometry, Design and Fabrication
outcomes: Predict wheel and steering changes from a drawing.
Fabricate a physical corner fixture and compare its measured travel with the prediction.
courses.assignment: A physical suspension corner, reviewed drawings, measured plots and a revision decision.

courses.title: Bodywork, Occupant Packaging and Refinishing
outcomes: Dimension access, sightlines and interfaces using real components.
Form, fit and refit a removable body panel against an original drawing.
courses.assignment: A learner-formed panel, physical fit check, finishing coupon or documented professional finish, and as-built body drawing.

stages.title: Individual vehicle capstone
stages.summary: Integrate the actual systems into one complete learner-built car and prove the agreed functions at a controlled site.
stages.milestone: A complete independently witnessed car, signed build dossier and closed critical findings.

courses.title: Capstone: Build and Commission Your Own Car
outcomes: Build and integrate a complete car and substantiate personal workmanship.
Demonstrate repeatable operation with witnessed testing and a serviceable as-built dossier.
courses.assignment: The complete car, accompanied by a build portfolio, verified service record and signed demonstration.
